mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, which features overcast skies and a temperature of 61 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. The current moon phase is the First Quarter.

City officials are reminding residents that the new Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan was recently adopted in September 2026 to guide future growth. Additionally, the Verona Police Department is actively seeking new patrol officers.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival kicks off in Paoli, and the Dane County Farmers' Market will be open at the Capitol.

Looking at the weekly report, on September 5th, officers were dispatched to several streets to investigate reports of vehicles with cheese slices placed on their windshields, which was identified as a social media trend.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently undergoing a remodel and is closed, but doors will open today at 10:00 AM for all your favorites.
